summary: Tested the Android-15 edge-to-edge keyboard-hiding-composer fix (preserveEdgeToEdge added to KeyboardProvider in _layout.tsx, react-native-keyboard-controller bumped to 1.18.5). IMPORTANT LIMITATION: this environment only has web/browser Playwright automation available (no Android 15+ emulator/device/APK build). Browser preview does NOT trigger a native on-screen keyboard that shifts the viewport the way Android's edge-to-edge keyboard-inset system does, so the actual reported native bug (composer hidden behind Android soft keyboard) COULD NOT be reproduced or verified in this environment. This matches the known_limitation flagged by the requesting agent. (1) Confirmed app loads with zero console errors / no red screen after the _layout.tsx and package.json changes across full flow: language select -> login -> chat -> settings -> signup -> forgot-password. (2) Chat composer (testID='send-button' present, placeholder 'Ask in English…') remains visible and functional when focused/typed into in the web preview -- text persists correctly while typing, no layout shift/clipping observed (best-effort web check only, per the caveat). (3) Full E2E regression: logged in as voicetest2026@example.com, sent chat message 'What is the fine for riding without a helmet?' -> got correct RAG answer (₹1,000 fine, 3-month licence suspension) with 'View Legal Details' citation link rendered, quota decremented 200->199->198 correctly. (4) Regression on other keyboard screens: login.tsx (email/password TextInput focus+fill works), signup.tsx (4 inputs incl. full name/email/phone/password, all focusable/fillable, no crash), forgot-password.tsx (KeyboardAwareScrollView, email input works), settings.tsx (loads correctly, profile card, preferences visible) -- no console errors on any screen. Did not deep-test delete-account.tsx modal or settings password-confirm modal interaction (time-boxed), but screen navigation itself showed no crashes elsewhere so risk is low.
action_items: CRITICAL CAVEAT (already known to main agent, reiterating): the actual Android-15 edge-to-edge native keyboard-inset bug CANNOT be verified in this sandboxed dev environment (no Android 15+ emulator/device/APK build available). All web-preview checks passed (no crashes, composer visible/functional, no console errors introduced by the preserveEdgeToEdge change), but this does NOT constitute confirmation that the native Android bug is fixed. A real device/APK build test on Android 15+ (API 35) is required post-deployment before closing this out as verified.
Optional follow-up: test delete-account.tsx KeyboardAwareScrollView and settings.tsx password-confirm modal TextInput explicitly in a future iteration if more time is available.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx change (adding preserveEdgeToEdge prop with a detailed comment explaining WHY it's needed given app.json's edgeToEdgeEnabled config vs the react-native-edge-to-edge package) is well-documented and matches official react-native-keyboard-controller guidance for apps not using the react-native-edge-to-edge package.

index.tsx chat screen's KeyboardAvoidingView (behavior='translate-with-padding', keyboardVerticalOffset=0) and inline comment justifying offset=0 look consistent with the fix's intent, but the real behavior can only be validated on native Android given the library's platform-specific inset calculations.
No regressions found in package.json bump to react-native-keyboard-controller 1.18.5 -- KeyboardAwareScrollView usage on forgot-password.tsx/delete-account.tsx unaffected in web preview.

This sandbox has no such capability. All available web-preview-based checks (app loads, no console errors, composer functional while typing, full chat/login/regression flows work) passed cleanly. Recommend the deployment pipeline includes a manual/automated native Android device smoke test for this specific fix before marking it fully resolved.
rca_of_issue: N/A -- this iteration verified a fix (not investigating a new bug). Original bug: on Android 15 (targetSdk 35) edge-to-edge enforcement, react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardProvider does not auto-detect this app's Expo-native android.edgeToEdgeEnabled config (it only auto-detects the react-native-edge-to-edge package), causing incorrect keyboard-height/inset math that hides the chat composer behind the on-screen keyboard. Fix: explicit preserveEdgeToEdge prop on KeyboardProvider + library patch bump. Verification of the actual fix on real Android 15 hardware is outside this environment's capability.
